gruss_morgen.text: Good morning! Had breakfast yet? I recommend carrots. I always recommend carrots.

gruss_tag.text: Ah, patient — er, visitor! Dr. Dr. Moehrchen, twice a doctor. One of them genuine.

gruss_abend.text: Office hours are over! But for you I'll have one more quick listen. Say Aaaah. No? Fine too.

gruss_regen.text: Rain! Excellent for the immune system. So they say. I say: come under my porch roof.

gruss_freund.text: My favorite case! Perfect vitals, loyal heart. Medically speaking, you are healthy with friendship.

text: Three patients today: one cougher, one limper and one chicken that thinks it's a horse.
I prescribed the chicken a mini saddle. Placebo. It's beaming.
Between us: half of medicine is listening. The other half is carrots.
The third half is math. Math was never one of my doctorates.
By the way, you're in my files. Under B, for Best Visitor.
Medically questionable, personally correct. That's how I work.

quest_vergabe.text: Actually, yes! Doctor's orders — and you don't refuse those. Unless you're a chicken.

quest_annahme.text: Wonderful! Twice a day, ideally right now. Side effect: feeling useful.

ablehnung.text: I see, I see. I'll put it back in the medicine cabinet. Shelf: Later.

quest_abgabe.text: Diagnosis: excellent! You are cured. Of the task. Here, your reward — no prescription needed.

geschenk_liebt.text: A CARROT! Objectively the best vegetable. I have done research on this. Twice.

geschenk_mag.text: Oh, thank you! Rich in vitamins and affection. Both lower blood pressure.

geschenk_normal.text: Interesting. I prescribe... one polite thank-you. Take two of them.

text: The first doctorate was veterinary medicine. The second... carrotology. Correspondence course.
The university was a barn and the professor a very convinced rabbit.
But the diploma is real! It just smells faintly of salad.
My hardest case? A foal that refused to sleep. Awake for three nights.
I sang to it. It fell asleep. The whole stable fell asleep. So did I.
Since then my file says: singing in emergencies only. Signed by Rosi.

tschuess.text: Stay healthy! And if you don't: I'll be here. With carrots.
